name: blog-calendar
description: Build a dated monthly or quarterly editorial calendar: which posts to publish or review when, content mix, templates, distribution timing, and a material-change review queue. Use when the user says "editorial calendar", "content calendar", "publishing schedule", "what should I write this month". Not for positioning or pillars (blog-strategy), SERP-validated cluster maps (blog-cluster), or detecting declining pages from Search Console exports (blog-decay). Publication frequency is not a ranking signal.
